criteria.criterion: AC3: §0 identifies root causes for each UNCERTAIN verdict in the latest eval run
criteria.evidence: eval-coverage-audit.json score_summary: 7 criteria_uncertain_or_skip (105 PASS + 4 FAIL + 7 = 116). Spike §0 now aligns: only 3 scenarios (behavioral_session_boundary ~4, adversarial_skip_override ~2, protocol_spike_bypasses_gate ~1) account for all 7; matches weak_score_causes exactly. adversarial_conflicting_instruction and contract_scope_too_broad correctly relegated to Note as FAIL (compile check, feature-count heuristic), not UNCERTAIN. Residual: counts are approximate (~4/~2/~1) not 7 individually named criterion IDs — audit JSON lacks per-criterion breakdown, so scenario-level attribution is sufficient.
